name: Circumcerebral 25->11 ms CCW (gamma study)
origin: Persinger lab, Laurentian University (Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004), circumcerebral 'Octopus' configuration
summary: One 5-min configuration from Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004: a counter-clockwise rotation around the head with 25 ms on the first coil and 2 ms less on each of the next seven (last 11 ms; the lab's "25+2"), repeating, here carrying the Thomas pulse. Persinger's lab reported more 35-45 Hz gamma power over frontal and occipital regions with this configuration (11 subjects).
notes: Checked and kept: the abstract gives "the first pulse for 25 ms followed by an acceleration of +2 ms to each of the other 7 solenoids (the last duration = 11 ms)", counter-clockwise in the horizontal plane above the ears, i.e. 25, 23 ... 11 ms and one turn of 144 ms (about 6.9 per second). The lab writes this "25+2", + meaning shorter (Persinger & Lavallee 2010), the opposite sign to the Koren software patent. Changed: the waveform. The abstract names none ("pulsed magnetic fields"); the lab describes its rotated field as "complex frequency-modulated" (Persinger & Lavallee 2010) and Saroka (2016) says Cook 1999 rotated the Thomas pulse on the Octopus, so the exact 849-point patent table now plays at the lab's usual 3 ms per point for this file with 3 ms between repeats (2.55 s per cycle; Buckner 2015; Murugan 2013), instead of a synthetic burst on rat timing (230 points of 4 ms every 3 s); each coil gets about 4-8 points. That choice is an inference; the lab's ring table of 2002 (Swann paper) also ran the Thomas file at 1 ms per point. This was one of six 5-min configurations, with EEG sampled after 2.5 min; the other five are not described, so this runs the one for its 5 min. The abstract gives no intensity; the lab measured 1-5 uT inside each solenoid of its ring (Lehman 2016), and the default is 1 uT. The ring layout (Fpz, F7, T7, P7, Oz, P8, T8, F8, counter-clockwise from above) starts on the midline, while the lab's coil 1 sat over the left frontal and coil 8 over the right prefrontal region; persinger-tsang-2004-gamma-thomas runs the same rotation on such a ring. Scalp gamma is easily contaminated by muscle and stimulation artefacts, which the paper does not say it removed, and one positive result among six conditions in 11 people may be chance. Single-lab EEG result with no independent replication; testing it needs EEG before, during and after. Independent double-blind tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012). Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Seated or reclined, eyes closed, in a quiet, dim room (the lab used an acoustic chamber). Record EEG before, during and after if you want to check the gamma claim.
schedule: At most weekly (Murphy's rule for circumcerebral Shiva sessions); six sessions, then a 21-day break.
source: Tsang, Koren & Persinger 2004, Int J Neurosci 114:1183-1193 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15370182/ ; Persinger & Lavallee 2010, J Conscious Explor Res 1(7):785-807 (base +/- change notation, "20+2" = 20, 18 ... 6 ms; coil 1 left frontal, coil 8 right prefrontal; sibling and yoked studies retold) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/99 ; Koren & Persinger, US 6,312,376 B1 (sequence interval and sequence acceleration) https://patents.google.com/patent/US6312376B1/en ; Saroka 2016, PhD dissertation, Laurentian University (Cook 1999 rotated the Thomas pulse with "the Octopus") https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/server/api/core/bitstreams/be015982-0b0f-4c27-a031-797637c364e1/content ; Thomas, Prato, Kavaliers & Persinger, US 6,234,953 B1, Table 1 and FIG. 2 "Thomas Pulse (Cnp)" https://patents.google.com/patent/US6234953B1/en ; Buckner et al. 2015, PLoS ONE 10(4):e0124136 (Thomas file: 849 points at 3 ms, 2.55 s per cycle) https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25875081 ; Murugan 2013, MSc thesis, Laurentian University (849 points for the Thomas pulse at 3 ms, 3 ms between repeats; 248 points for burst-x) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/39c9c1ad-70ba-458d-a819-d24c20da217a ; Lehman 2016, MSc thesis, Laurentian University, pp. 56-57 ("20-2" = 20, 22 ... 34 ms; 1-5 uT inside each solenoid) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/e809389f-805c-4414-8177-d0bf8d7127bb ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1-6 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
